newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico economic recovery may push up coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: Mexico economic recovery may push up coffee prices.

text.p: A recovery of the Mexican economy after the crippling 1995 recession could lead to upward pressure on world coffee prices because growers will be less driven to make quick physical sales, coffee sources say.
Mexican producers exported record amounts of beans in the 1995-1996 cycle -- partly because they were forced to sell fast at punitive prices to pay down debts as interest rates spiraled.
